note: One entry per community we post in. The landing page answers /join/<source> (website/src/pages/Join.tsx); the source is the last part of the path, so Cloudflare Web Analytics shows it under Path. `invite` is a Discord invite created for that source, so the invite's use count shows who joined from it; null falls back to the plain invite. Add a source here before its first post and record it in docs/community/outreach/tracker.md.
